remarks: Built by ATTESA Homes, this brand-new 2-storey home in The Brickyard offers over 2,200 SQ FT of thoughtfully designed living space. Featuring 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and a bright OPEN-TO-BELOW main floor, this home is designed for modern family living and entertaining. The stylish kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious living area, highlighted by the impressive open-to-below feature, large windows, and abundant natural light. Upstairs offers generously sized bedrooms, including a comfortable primary retreat. The basement includes a separate entrance and is ready for future development, offering excellent potential for additional living space. Located in the family-friendly community of The Brickyard in Stony Plain, close to walking trails, schools, shopping, parks, and everyday amenities, with convenient access to Edmonton. (id:67522)
